**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Review PR #331 (issue #210, release audit gate ordering) using brain's own methodologies → judgment-day dual blind review → fix the blocker found underneath → attack the systemic pattern behind it → lay a roadmap and ticket it, fully linked to the epic.

## Instructions (owner preferences learned)
- **Everything must be tracked AND linked bidirectionally.** Filing a child that says `Part of #313` is NOT sufficient — the epic body must be edited in the same pass. The owner caught me repeating exactly the M8 rot; do this unprompted from now on.
- Never bypass a human approval gate on the owner's behalf, even when work was verbally authorized. `status:approved` is their keystroke.
- Verify claims before agreeing. The owner said an agent had started #317; verified there was no branch/PR/worktree and said so plainly. (Later confirmed: #317 now has `status:approved` and is assigned to `csrinaldibot`.)

## Discoveries
- **THE SYSTEMIC PATTERN — "seam blindness"**: logic is correct and well tested; the failure lives at the seam where it meets something it does not control. FOUR instances in one session: #317 (`prReviews` drops `body` at `github.mjs:291` → priorVerdicts always empty), #210/#331 (gate runs after the tag), #334 (`brain:ship` hardcodes a nonexistent `kind:feature` label at `brain-ship.mjs:94`), #340 (local `issueLink` at `issue-link.mjs:23` accepts `Part of #N` unconditionally while CI branches on base branch — `brain:check` greenlights PRs CI rejects). TWO of the four were found by accident while doing something else.
- **CORRECTED a wrong first hypothesis**: "brain lacks negative tests" is FALSE. Measured: phase-order-check 15 failure assertions, actor-check 9, brain-audit 8. 1899 tests green. The gates ARE proven able to fail — only against inputs the tests themselves author.
- **The antidote already exists in the repo**: `vcs.contract.test.mjs`, a parameterized contract suite with `_provenance.recorded` vs `derived` fixtures. Two gaps: (A) uncovered verbs — `prReviews` is the ONE verb the reviewer needs and the ONE without a pinned contract; (B) mutating writes cannot be recorded, so derived fixtures encode the author's assumption — fixture and code share the same wrong belief, which is exactly #334.
- **PR #331 verdict**: 12 findings confirmed by both blind judges, 0 contradictions, 6 CRITICAL. Only REQ-210-3 landed and it was already satisfied by pre-existing code. Includes a Tier 3 governance violation: ADR-0025 committed straight to `brain/project/decisions/` as `Status: Accepted`, bypassing `brain-drafts/`, while the PR body claimed a `brain-drafts/` file that is not in the diff.
- **#332 root cause**: `git-seam.mjs` `execFileSync` had no `maxBuffer` → Node's 1 MiB default. `e5371dc`'s `--binary` diff is 3,964,248 bytes because `.memory/records/*.jsonl` is committed and grows monotonically. ENOBUFS carries no git exit code → collapsed to `-1` → `audit-uncomputable`.
- **`gh pr edit` is broken** on this repo (projects-classic deprecation GraphQL error). Use `gh api -X PATCH repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n} -F body=@file`.
- **GitHub forbids `--request-changes` on your own PR.** Post the verdict as a comment instead.
- **brain has NO issue-creation verb.** The VCS port exposes none; `brain:start <n>` consumes an existing approved issue.
- **Ordering matters against #328's race**: approve the issue FIRST, then edit the PR body. The edit re-triggers the gates so they evaluate against real state. Reverse order leaves a stuck red.

## Accomplished
- **PR #331**: REQUEST CHANGES posted as a comment with all 12 confirmed findings.
- **#332 filed and FIXED** — PR #333, 8/8 CI green. Strict TDD: red first (`expected status 0, got -1 (stderr: )` — the empty stderr WAS the second bug). 256 MiB explicit ceiling, kept finite deliberately; ENOBUFS special-cased before the generic fallback so the reason survives. `brain-audit v1.0.0..origin/main` went EXIT=2 uncomputable → EXIT=0. Suite 1899/1899.
- **#334 filed** — `brain:ship` label defect, with the analysis of why its mocked test can never catch it.
- **M10 designed and ticketed**: #335 (parent), #336 (P1 coverage audit), #337 (P3 efficacy probe), #339 (doc), #340 (local/CI divergence).
- **EPIC #313 EDITED**: sequence changed to `M10(P0,P1,P3) → #210 → M2 → …`; the "#210 is the first item of 1.1" prose rewritten; M10 milestone entry added; the recurring meta-defect recorded in Tracking gaps.
- **Bidirectional links** posted on #210, #317, #334, #335, #336, #337.
- **PR #338**: `docs/inbox/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md`, 8/8 green.
- Handoff briefing written for the #317 agent (the fixture-must-be-recorded paragraph is the load-bearing part).

## Next Steps
- **Merge #333 and #338** — both green.
- **Decide #331**: reduce to its honest slice (the `auditBaseline` line) or close and rebuild under #210.
- **Approve** #334, #336, #337, #340 (all `status:needs-review`).
- **Answer M10 open question 1** BEFORE #336 runs: is M10 a milestone, or a cross-cutting standard every later milestone must meet? Four instances (two accidental) argue strongly for the standard. It changes how #336's children get ticketed.
- **#330 should rise in priority**: `.memory/index.jsonl` has no merge strategy and conflicts on every parallel branch. With `csrinaldibot` now active on #317 plus open PRs, this stops being theoretical.
- **#317 is approved and assigned to csrinaldibot** — deliver the handoff briefing, minus its now-stale `status:approved` bullet.

## Relevant Files
- `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/git-seam.mjs` — maxBuffer + ENOBUFS legibility (fixed, #332)
- `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/git-seam.test.mjs` — two new seam tests
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs:291` — `prReviews` drops `body` (#317, unfixed)
- `brain/scripts/brain-ship.mjs:94` — hardcoded `kind:feature` (#334, unfixed)
- `brain/scripts/governance/checks/issue-link.mjs:23` — accepts `Part of` unconditionally (#340, unfixed)
- `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs:78-88` — presence probe, not efficacy (#337, unfixed)
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs` — the mechanism to extend
- `docs/inbox/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md` — the roadmap (PR #338)
- `~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/seam-contract-coverage-roadmap.md` — local copy, synced
